meaning: The previously authorized 68-byte immutable test file remained available at the warmed URL with CF cache HIT. A cacheNonce request was denied and the removed member could not obtain a new signature. This proves fresh authorization denial, not immediate withdrawal of an already-cached copy.
next_scope: Boundedly compare warm and cold signed URL expiry and supported cache settings with harmless Personal proof files; no new Family or modeled Auth session is needed.
acceptance_limit: Do not claim that cache:no-store, private/no-cache headers, a browser TTL reduction or short signed token expiry by themselves guarantee immediate revocation. Verify current provider behavior before a stronger serving contract.
